Read in (X,z) jointly it is a plane quartic-type relation, not shown to be genus 1. The j-invariant and the monodromy = holonomy H₁,H₂ claims are not encoded. The statement also uses X both for the triple (x₂,x₃,x₄) and a scalar. prf: a 6-line sketch ("reducing by Newton identities yields the cubic") with an unspecified constant C; never computes the cubic, the curve, j, or the monodromy.
